newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING issues call warrants NBM-Amstelland.
newsitem.headline: ING issues call warrants NBM-Amstelland.

text.p: ING Bank said on Tuesday it would issue 1.5 million call warrants on convertible preference shares of construction firm NBM-Amstelland NV.
Each warrant will carry the right to buy one convertible preference share in NBM-Amstelland at a price of 47 guilders on February 17, 1999.
The warrants, which will be listed on the Amsterdam bourse, can only be exercised in lots of 100 and cannot be called before the expiry date.
ING Bank said it would start privately placing the call warrants from February 26. Payment should take place on March 5.
The bank added the call warrants were the sole responsibility of ING Bank and that the warrants do not carry any voting or dividend rights in NBM-Amstelland.
